summary: Make capability accumulation, Foundry validation and evidence-backed service creation mandatory before registering any new user-facing EKODI service.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI in ChatGPT on 2026-09-23 to make the capability-before-service operating model a mandatory rule after approving internal Capability Foundry and Sample Service construction.
adds: existing Capability search is mandatory before any new user-facing service registration
a capability gap must be addressed in Capability Foundry before service packaging
synthetic sample validation must precede a new service
at least three verified sample runs are required
explicit user demand, measured recurring need, or a security/legal/reliability requirement is required
EKODI Platform Super Administrator packaging review is required
automatic user-facing service creation is forbidden
new service registration without evidence fails CI
new independent deployment boundaries still require the sustainable boundary-creation gate
preserves: all existing services as the adoption baseline only
rollback: Revert Constitution v1.21.0 capability-before-service policy, its validator, evidence registry and Foundry alignment while preserving all services, Capability modules, user data and the v1.20.0 authentication-return-continuity constitution.
